messages.subject: DRUG this week: Wickson 1017 (Fri 10-12)
parts:
This week's DRUG meeting will be in Wickson 1017.  It will be there next week (10/19) as well, and then starting 10/26 we will be in PES 2005 for the remainder of the quarter.

For the first part of our work session, Jacob Teter (TTP) will present a "Show and Tell" from about 10-10:30.  From Jacob:

This stretch of script takes daily resolution climate (max/min temp., precipitation, and derived reference evapotranspiration) data - creates a raster field using thin-plate splines (and potentially also calculates standard error), then combines it with rasterized soil texture data (from SSURGO), and satellite-derived location data on cropping patterns for economically important crops. After joining the fields from these three data sources (climate, soil, cropping patterns) in the same coordinate reference system and resolution, we write them out into a simple data.frame that can then be used as inputs for a process-based crop-water-soil-atmosphere model (AquaCrop).
 
The spatial components of this workflow will be illustrated using data from Kansas.
 
I'll also ask about better data sources and better practices for making the above sequence of steps happen efficiently.

See you Friday,

Noam
